import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 31;
    static final long P = 1000000007L;
    static int n;
    static long[][] matrix = new long[MAX][MAX];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] t = new long[MAX][MAX];

        void identity() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1 : 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void multiply(Matrix b) {
            long[][] temp = new long[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    temp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        temp[i][k] += t[i][j] * b.t[j][k] % P;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    t[i][j] = temp[i][j] % P;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m_input = sc.nextLong();
        int k_input = sc.nextInt();
        long m = m_input;
        int k = k_input;

        List<Long> baseDigits = new ArrayList<>();
        while (m > 0) {
            baseDigits.add(m % k);
            m /= k;
        }

        n = k + 1;

        Matrix baseMatrix = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            baseMatrix.t[i][(i + 1) % k] = 1;
        }
        baseMatrix.t[k][k] = 1;

        Matrix identityMatrix = new Matrix();
        identityMatrix.identity();

        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            baseMatrix.t[0][i] = 1;
            baseMatrix.t[i][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] d = new Matrix[baseDigits.size()];
        d[0] = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(identityMatrix.t[i], 0, d[0].t[i], 0, n);
        }
        d[0].multiply(baseMatrix);

        for (int i = 1; i < baseDigits.size(); i++) {
            d[i] = new Matrix();
            // copy previous
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                System.arraycopy(d[i - 1].t[r], 0, d[i].t[r], 0, n);
            }
            // square d[i]
            d[i].multiply(d[i]);
            // multiply by baseMatrix
            d[i].multiply(baseMatrix);
        }

        long[] result = new long[n];
        Arrays.fill(result, 1);

        for (int idx = baseDigits.size() - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            long[] power = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                power[i] = 0;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    power[j] += result[i] * d[idx].t[i][j] % P;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                result[i] = power[i] % P;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(result[k]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
